findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Freight.Rules.coverPremium matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). No accepted authority: numeric literal 0 (line 15): value 0 equals no declared parameter of an accepted or superseded record. Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.

Rule-bearing legacy code in Freight.Rules.oversizeFee matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). No accepted authority: wildcard default returning 0m for unlisted cases (line 32): value 0 equals no declared parameter of an accepted or superseded record; cited DEC-FR13 declares oversize-fees.REMOTE=42.00, oversize-fees.RURAL=17.50, p1=150, not 0. Supported (matching rule): case keyed on "REMOTE" (line 30): (c) comment citation, "REMOTE" is named by accepted DEC-FR13, cited in the declaration's comment; numeric literal 42.00 (line 30): (c) comment citation, value 42.00 = DEC-FR13.oversize-fees.REMOTE (accepted, same form), cited in the declaration's comment; case keyed on "RURAL" (line 31): (c) comment citation, "RURAL" is named by accepted DEC-FR13, cited in the declaration's comment; numeric literal 17.50 (line 31): (c) comment citation, value 17.50 = DEC-FR13.oversize-fees.RURAL (accepted, same form), cited in the declaration's comment. A wildcard default silently decides every unlisted case; no record authorizes that default. Question for Network Operations: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
